audience: CMS authors and developers using the last published content through REST APIs

context.status: One state line using publication metadata. Fixed folder wording, no count or execution/access claim. No internal delivery jargon.
context.steps: Linear key/copy/publish guidance. Publishing remains in the editor header; CMS never manages keys here.
context.options: Contract-backed progressive options. Sort combines field/direction. Search matches title or description. ID is always returned.
context.preview: Static JSON only, never live content. Protocol identifiers remain unchanged.
context.editor: API publishing hub and one shared panel. Existing authoring save/publish behavior remains unchanged.
context.hosts: Existing metadata navigation labels and safe public-API configuration errors. Root has no API toolbar action.
context.fields: Labels are translated; JSON field names remain protocol syntax.
context.validation: Polite field errors with bounded whole-number/item/character limits; do not render raw validator details.

security.secretPolicy: Never interpolate credentials, raw errors or URLs into translated messages.
security.linkPolicy: Workspace Admin URL is built from the existing safe origin allowlist.
